name: 06880 · Westport, CT
findings: ZIP 06880 (Westport) has 253 nonprofit organizations. 96 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 80 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06880 (Westport) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06880 (Westport) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 5.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
